items.text: SEMI-SHOCK: Goldman is acquiring Neos ETFs for $2.3b. Huge coup for Neos who is only few yrs old but got big FAST, $32b, mostly in covered call monthly income ETFs. GS clearly sees big future in boomer candy, after buying Neos (covered call) and Innovator (buffers) back to back.
